profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer, Capital One
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Michael Joshua Smith is a Lead Software Engineer at Capital One, building scalable cloud-native applications with AWS, Python, Java, and PySpark. At GE Power, he led enterprise cloud migrations to AWS and Azure, with a focus on automation and security best practices. He holds a master’s in Computer Science from Georgia Tech and has experience building AI-powered apps using OpenAI integrations. Michael is also AWS-certified and passionate about applying cloud and AI technologies to real-world challenges.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Principal Associate
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Responsible for spearheading the development and maintenance of business-critical applications focused on credit decisioning. Specialized in utilizing technologies such as Python, PySpark, Java, Jenkins, EMR, Lambda, and various other AWS cloud services to ensure robust, scalable, and efficient system operations. The role involves leading cross-functional teams to innovate and enhance application capabilities, driving continuous improvement through agile methodologies and DevOps practices. Requires a strong technical background and a proactive approach to problem-solving to meet the evolving needs of the business.

positions.title: Sr. Enterprise Application Engineer
positions.description: Leading initiatives to transition enterprise-grade apps/servers from data-centers to AWS & Azure cloud platforms. Created automation  to integrate AWS account instances with CI/CD pipeline and ensure all corporate controls are integrated & available. Leading effort to define Azure adoption strategy within GE Gas Power. Identity & Access Management. VNET, Subnetting, NSG/ASG. Governance (naming & tagging) & Security Best-Practices.

positions.title: Emerging Technology and Cloud Developer (DTLP 4th Rotation)
positions.description: Product development, evaluation, automation, and deployment of AWS services. Example: Build a rollout plan and develop scripts for AWS operation automation. Develop POC(s) for emerging technologies and cloud (AWS) services. Aspiring AWS Solutions Architect Associate.

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer (DTLP 3rd Rotation)
positions.description: Collaborated with Edison Engineering Development Program (EEDP) members to automate process capability models and other statistical tests to study the performance of additively manufactured gas turbine parts. Reduced overhead cost by ~$10k/engine set. Utilized "Pandas" library to process, visualize, and display emerging data patterns to fellow engineers and leadership.

positions.title: Software & Analytics Developer (DTLP 2nd Rotation)
positions.description: Built responsive web-interface from scratch using Angular 6 & Angular Material. Upon completing the UI, I worked with senior engineers to design and incorporate new functionalities through Spring Boot API & SQL database. Once there, our team containerized our code base using Docker & configured our environment using Jenkins pipelines for DEV, QA & PROD environments.

positions.title: Product Security Engineer (DTLP 1st Rotation)
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a vulnerability management web-application with functionality for creating visual diagrams of system components.

Collaborated with team to design and implement Javascript diagramming library, REST API, and NoSQL database structure. During the project, I utilized the following technologies: AngularJS, React, Express, Node, MongoDB, Docker, Openshift (Containerization Software), CentOS 7, Ubuntu 18.04.

positions.title: Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
Designing, developing, delivering proprietary software solutions based on business-specific challenges and objectives.
- Email Address Web-Scraping Pipeline: Python, Selenium, Phantom Buster, Google Drive API, AWS. Generated 7,000+ new business contacts from 100+ School Districts.

positions.title: Web Developer Internship
positions.description: Built data-driven websites using HTML, CSS, JQuery, Bootstrap and server-side languages such as PHP and Java. Incorporating database solutions using MySQL and SQL Server.

positions.title: Digital Technology Leadership Program (DTLP) Intern
positions.description:
Developed scripts using Java that detect duplicate Dell Boomi Connectors.
Created large-scale data integrations using Dell Boomi.
Learned about web service protocols such as SOAP, and REST.
Dell Boomi Certified!

positions.title: Front-End Web Development Intern
positions.description: During the spring semester of 2017, I created responsive web-pages using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JQuery, and Bootstrap for the Benjamin Center of SUNY New Paltz. Creating a project using the Google Maps JavaScript API.

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description: IT consultant for businesses in the New York City area. Installed and maintained systems for clients of varying industries and providing comprehensive solutions and support to ensure that they remain stable, secure, and running.

positions.title: Peer Tutor
positions.description:
Working individually with students enrolled in Computer Science I, Computer Science II, and Calculus II. 
Concepts include, but are not limited to:
* Java Programming.
* Object Oriented Programming
* Data Structures.
* Assembly & Machine Language.
* Discrete Mathematics.
* Calculus I & II

positions.title: Visual Basic Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Grading source code based on it's correspondence with the given instructions, and it's computational efficiency. Occasionally creating custom test problems and homework/lab assignments. Frequently providing private or group tutoring sessions with students.

honors.title: Outstanding Graduate
honors.description: A long-time tradition of SUNY New Paltz, this reception provides a celebratory venue for the President, Provost, Deans and department/program chairs to recognize those students (undergraduate and graduate) selected by their departments as "Outstanding."
honors.issuer: Issued by SUNY New Paltz · Dec 2017

honors.title: Dean's List, and President's List.
honors.description:
Dean's list at SUNY Cortland three semesters: Spring 2014, Fall 2014, Spring 2015.
Dean's list at SUNY New Paltz every semester: Fall 2015, Spring 2016, Fall 2016, Spring 2017, Fall 2017.
GPA of at least 3.3 every semester for 3+ years.
honors.issuer: Issued by SUNY New Paltz · May 2017

volunteerExperiences.description:
Led a 7 person recruitment committee. Over a single semester, 
tied the chapter record of a 30% growth rate. Managed $1000+ budget for engagement events with various organizations.
